prompts: Edit target: the supplied human sprite parts atlas. These hidden overlap caps extend beyond the internal pivot by at least the local half-width and are fully filled with matching skin/cloth, smooth uniform local shading, no dark ring or transverse contour. Limbs straight vertical proximal TOP distal BOTTOM with natural taper. Existing atlas has bad straight cuts: replace these, do not preserve them. Flat 2D silhouette, not disconnected product photography. True transparent alpha, no colored fringes, no floating specks, no shadows cast outside parts. No complete assembled character, text, grid, watermark.
